scenarios.title: The forwarded screenshot
scenarios.scene: A cropped screenshot in your class group accuses a student of cheating. Nobody has shared the original conversation. A friend asks you to forward it to another group.

options.text: Ask for the original source before sharing.
options.consequence: You slow the spread and make room to check what happened.

options.text: Forward it with a question mark.
options.consequence: A question mark does not prevent the accusation from spreading.

options.text: Publicly accuse the person who posted it of lying.
options.consequence: You add a second unverified accusation to the first.

scenarios.followup: The original conversation shows that the screenshot left out an important sentence.
scenarios.prompt2: How do you help repair the situation?

options2.text: Share a clear correction wherever you shared the claim.
options2.consequence: A correction reaches the people who may have received the accusation.

options2.text: Delete your message and say nothing.
options2.consequence: Deletion limits further sharing, but earlier readers may still believe the accusation.

options2.text: Keep arguing about who started it.
options2.consequence: The argument can distract from correcting the false impression.

scenarios.takeaway: Verify claims before amplifying them, and make corrections visible to the same audience.

passage.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن جَآءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌۢ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟ أَن تُصِيبُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بِجَهَـٰلَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَـٰدِمِينَ
passage.translation: O ye who believe! If an evil-liver bring you tidings, verify it, lest ye smite some folk in ignorance and afterward repent of what ye did.

scenarios.title: The extra marks
scenarios.scene: Your teacher accidentally awards you five extra marks. The result moves you above a classmate. You notice the error after everyone has left.

options.text: Privately tell the teacher about the marking error.
options.consequence: You give the teacher a chance to correct the result.

options.text: Wait to see whether anyone notices.
options.consequence: The result remains misleading while you wait.

options.text: Tell your classmate to demand more marks too.
options.consequence: Another incorrect score would not correct the original error.

scenarios.followup: The teacher thanks you and offers to review the whole paper.

options2.text: An accurate review using the same criteria as everyone else.
options2.consequence: You keep the focus on fairness rather than a personal reward.

options2.text: Extra credit for being honest.
options2.consequence: The request can turn a correction into a negotiation for advantage.

options2.text: A public announcement about your honesty.
options2.consequence: Public praise may shift attention away from an accurate result.

scenarios.takeaway: Honesty can involve correcting an error that benefits you.

passage.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَكُونُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
passage.translation: O ye who believe! Be careful of your duty to Allah, and be with the truthful.

scenarios.title: A promise and a deadline
scenarios.scene: You promised to help a friend move on Saturday. A new project deadline now conflicts with the same time. Your friend is counting on your help.

options.text: Tell your friend early and discuss a realistic alternative.
options.consequence: Early communication gives both of you time to make another plan.

options.text: Stay silent until Saturday morning.
options.consequence: Your friend loses time to arrange help.

options.text: Say that you never made a firm promise.
options.consequence: Denying a clear commitment can damage trust.

scenarios.followup: Your friend says they mainly need help carrying one heavy item.

options2.text: Offer a specific time you can actually keep, or help find another person.
options2.consequence: A realistic arrangement is more dependable than an uncertain assurance.

options2.text: Promise the whole day again despite the deadline.
options2.consequence: Another unrealistic promise may repeat the problem.

options2.text: Tell them they should not depend on anyone.
options2.consequence: That response avoids addressing the commitment you made.

scenarios.takeaway: Take commitments seriously, communicate conflicts early, and agree only to what you can do.

passage.arabic: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ مَالَ ٱلْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَوْفُوا۟ بِٱلْعَهْدِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلْعَهْدَ كَانَ مَسْـُٔولًا
passage.translation: Come not near the wealth of the orphan save with that which is better till he come to strength; and keep the covenant. Lo! of the covenant it will be asked.

scenarios.title: A difficult conversation at home
scenarios.scene: A parent asks for help setting up their phone while you are trying to finish an assignment. You have explained the same steps several times already.

options.text: Speak gently and agree on a time you can give full attention.
options.consequence: You acknowledge the request while explaining your time limit.

options.text: Snap that they should know this by now.
options.consequence: The words may hurt even if you are tired.

options.text: Pretend you cannot hear.
options.consequence: The request stays unresolved and can feel dismissive.

scenarios.followup: They say they need to make an important call soon.

options2.text: Help with the urgent call, then return to the full setup later.
options2.consequence: You separate an immediate need from a task that can wait.

options2.text: Rush through every setting without explaining.
options2.consequence: The phone may work now, but the same difficulty can return.

options2.text: Take the phone away until your assignment is finished.
options2.consequence: That removes their access rather than addressing the urgent need.

scenarios.takeaway: Respectful speech and a practical boundary can coexist.

passage.arabic: ۞ وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَـٰنًا ۚ إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ ٱلْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفٍّ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًا كَرِيمًا
passage.translation: Thy Lord hath decreed, that ye worship none save Him, and (that ye show) kindness to parents. If one of them or both of them attain old age with thee, say not "Fie" unto them nor repulse them, but speak unto them a gracious word.

scenarios.title: The reply you almost sent
scenarios.scene: A teammate dismisses your work in a public chat. You type an angry reply and hover over Send.

options.text: Pause and draft a calm response after you cool down.
options.consequence: You give yourself a chance to respond without escalating.

options.text: Send the harsh reply immediately.
options.consequence: The conflict may spread beyond the original disagreement.

options.text: Post an unrelated embarrassing story about them.
options.consequence: The response targets the person rather than the work.

scenarios.followup: Later, your teammate admits that their comment was careless.
scenarios.prompt2: How do you move the discussion forward?

options2.text: Acknowledge the apology and explain how to give useful feedback next time.
options2.consequence: You address the harm and suggest a clearer way to work together.

options2.text: Demand that everyone choose a side.
options2.consequence: A wider dispute may make repair harder.

options2.text: Use the apology to mock them.
options2.consequence: That can restart the cycle of public embarrassment.

scenarios.takeaway: A pause can create room for proportionate responses and repair.

passage.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ فِى ٱلسَّرَّآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ وَٱلْكَـٰظِمِينَ ٱلْغَيْظَ وَٱلْعَافِينَ عَنِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
passage.translation: Those who spend (of that which Allah hath given them) in ease and in adversity, those who control their wrath and are forgiving toward mankind; Allah loveth the good;

scenarios.title: The payment sent twice
scenarios.scene: A client accidentally pays the same invoice twice. You could use the money, and the client has not noticed.

options.text: Tell the client and arrange a refund or documented credit.
options.consequence: The client can choose how the overpayment should be handled.

options.text: Treat it as a bonus without asking.
options.consequence: The payment may not reflect the client's intention.

options.text: Wait until the next invoice and quietly deduct it.
options.consequence: An unexplained change leaves the accounting unclear.

scenarios.followup: The client asks for a refund, but bank fees will apply.
scenarios.prompt2: How do you handle the details?

options2.text: Explain the fees and agree on a transparent refund method.
options2.consequence: Both sides understand what amount will be returned and why.

options2.text: Deduct an extra convenience charge without notice.
options2.consequence: The unexplained deduction creates a new disagreement.

options2.text: Delay the refund because the fees are annoying.
options2.consequence: The client remains without the money they asked to recover.

scenarios.takeaway: Handle another person's property transparently and return what was entrusted.

passage.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَن تُؤَدُّوا۟ ٱلْأَمَـٰنَـٰتِ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهَا وَإِذَا حَكَمْتُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ أَن تَحْكُمُوا۟ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ نِعِمَّا يَعِظُكُم بِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
passage.translation: Lo! Allah commandeth you that ye restore deposits to their owners, and, if ye judge between mankind, that ye judge justly. Lo! comely is this which Allah admonisheth you. Lo! Allah is ever Hearer, Seer.

scenarios.title: The noisy evening
scenarios.scene: Friends are visiting your flat. A neighbor knocks and explains that their child is trying to sleep before an early appointment.

options.text: Thank them for telling you and lower the noise.
options.consequence: You can keep the visit enjoyable while reducing the disturbance.

options.text: Say that the building rules allow noise until later.
options.consequence: A rule may not address the neighbor's immediate difficulty.

options.text: Make a joke about the complaint in front of everyone.
options.consequence: The neighbor may feel humiliated for raising a practical concern.

scenarios.followup: Your friends suggest turning the music back up after the neighbor leaves.

options2.text: Explain the request and suggest a quieter activity.
options2.consequence: You make the adjustment understandable to the group.

options2.text: Agree because the neighbor is no longer watching.
options2.consequence: The disturbance returns even though the need has not changed.

options2.text: End the gathering angrily and blame the neighbor.
options2.consequence: Blame can turn a manageable issue into resentment.

scenarios.takeaway: Consider the effect of ordinary activities on people living nearby.

passage.arabic: ۞ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُشْرِكُوا۟ بِهِۦ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَـٰنًا وَبِذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَـٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَـٰكِينِ وَٱلْجَارِ ذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْجَارِ ٱلْجُنُبِ وَٱلصَّاحِبِ بِٱلْجَنۢبِ وَٱبْنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ مَن كَانَ مُخْتَالًا فَخُورًا
passage.translation: And serve Allah. Ascribe no thing as partner unto Him. (Show) kindness unto parents, and unto near kindred, and orphans, and the needy, and unto the neighbour who is of kin (unto you) and the neighbour who is not of kin, and the fellow-traveller and the wayfarer and (the slaves) whom your right hands possess. Lo! Allah loveth not such as are proud and boastful,

scenarios.title: The lunch-table story
scenarios.scene: At lunch, someone starts sharing a coworker's private mistake for laughs. The coworker is not present.

options.text: Redirect the conversation without adding details.
options.consequence: You avoid increasing the person's embarrassment.

options.text: Add a similar private story.
options.consequence: More details spread information the coworker did not choose to share.

options.text: Record the conversation to confront everyone later.
options.consequence: Recording can create another privacy problem.

scenarios.followup: A friend asks why you changed the subject.

options2.text: Say privately that the coworker would likely dislike the story being shared.
options2.consequence: You explain the concern without repeating the story.

options2.text: Retell the entire story to illustrate your point.
options2.consequence: The explanation spreads the same private information again.

options2.text: Call everyone bad people.
options2.consequence: A personal attack can make reflection less likely.

scenarios.takeaway: A story can be true and still be an unkind disclosure.

passage.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ ۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا۟ وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا ۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ رَّحِيمٌ
passage.translation: O ye who believe! Shun much suspicion; for lo! some suspicion is a crime. And spy not, neither backbite one another. Would one of you love to eat the flesh of his dead brother? Ye abhor that (so abhor the other)! And keep your duty (to Allah). Lo! Allah is Relenting, Merciful.

scenarios.title: The joke at someone's expense
scenarios.scene: A newcomer mispronounces a word during a club meeting. Others repeat the mistake as a running joke. The newcomer stops participating.

options.text: Use their name respectfully and invite them back into the discussion.
options.consequence: You make space for the person without repeating the joke.

options.text: Join the joke so the group accepts you.
options.consequence: The newcomer experiences another person joining the ridicule.

options.text: Explain that they need a thicker skin.
options.consequence: That response dismisses the effect of the repeated joke.

scenarios.followup: The organizer asks for a suggestion for the next meeting.

options2.text: Set a clear expectation against ridicule and make introductions welcoming.
options2.consequence: A shared expectation can reduce the chance of repetition.

options2.text: Ban the newcomer from speaking until they improve.
options2.consequence: Exclusion addresses neither the joke nor the harm.

options2.text: Name and shame every participant publicly.
options2.consequence: A new round of humiliation can reproduce the same pattern.

scenarios.takeaway: Protect people's dignity in everyday group interactions.

passage.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌ مِّن قَوْمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُوا۟ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَآءٌ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُنَّ ۖ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا۟ بِٱلْأَلْقَـٰبِ ۖ بِئْسَ ٱلِٱسْمُ ٱلْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ ٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَتُبْ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
passage.translation: O ye who believe! Let not a folk deride a folk who may be better than they (are), not let women (deride) women who may be better than they are; neither defame one another, nor insult one another by nicknames. Bad is the name of lewdness after faith. And whoso turneth not in repentance, such are evil-doers.

scenarios.title: A gift with a caption
scenarios.scene: You help a friend pay for groceries. Later you consider posting a photo that identifies them and describes their financial difficulty.

options.text: Keep their circumstances private and share a general message if useful.
options.consequence: You can encourage generosity without exposing your friend.

options.text: Post the photo because you paid.
options.consequence: The gift does not automatically give permission to share their circumstances.

options.text: Ask them to praise you publicly.
options.consequence: A public obligation can make the support feel conditional.

scenarios.followup: Someone asks you for proof that you helped.

options2.text: Explain that you will not disclose someone else's private circumstances.
options2.consequence: You protect the recipient's dignity while answering the request.

options2.text: Send them the friend's messages privately.
options2.consequence: A smaller audience still receives private information.

options2.text: Remind your friend that they owe you publicity.
options2.consequence: The request adds pressure after the gift.

scenarios.takeaway: Consider dignity and harm alongside the act of giving.

passage.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُبْطِلُوا۟ صَدَقَـٰتِكُم بِٱلْمَنِّ وَٱلْأَذَىٰ كَٱلَّذِى يُنفِقُ مَالَهُۥ رِئَآءَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ ۖ فَمَثَلُهُۥ كَمَثَلِ صَفْوَانٍ عَلَيْهِ تُرَابٌ فَأَصَابَهُۥ وَابِلٌ فَتَرَكَهُۥ صَلْدًا ۖ لَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ مِّمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
passage.translation: O ye who believe! Render not vain your almsgiving by reproach and injury, like him who spendeth his wealth only to be seen of men and believeth not in Allah and the Last Day. His likeness is as the likeness of a rock whereon is dust of earth; a rainstorm smiteth it, leaving it smooth and bare. They have no control of aught of that which they have gained. Allah guideth not the disbelieving folk.

scenarios.title: Too much on the plate
scenarios.scene: At a buffet, you want to try everything. You already have more food than you are likely to finish.

options.text: Take a small portion first and return if still hungry.
options.consequence: You can enjoy the meal while reducing likely waste.

options.text: Keep adding food because it is included in the price.
options.consequence: The price does not change how much you can eat.

options.text: Pressure a friend to finish your leftovers.
options.consequence: The excess becomes someone else's burden.

scenarios.followup: There is food left at the end of the event.

options2.text: Ask the organizer about safe packing or an established food-sharing arrangement.
options2.consequence: A safe plan can put usable food to better use.

options2.text: Give away food without checking whether it has been stored safely.
options2.consequence: Good intentions do not remove food-safety concerns.

options2.text: Make a public accusation against the hosts.
options2.consequence: Blame alone does not arrange a safe use for the food.

scenarios.takeaway: Avoid excess and use practical judgment when reducing waste.

passage.arabic: ۞ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ خُذُوا۟ زِينَتَكُمْ عِندَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ وَكُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ وَلَا تُسْرِفُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
passage.translation: O Children of Adam! Look to your adornment at every place of worship, and eat and drink, but be not prodigal. Lo! He loveth not the prodigals.

scenarios.title: The comment section
scenarios.scene: A person posts a view you strongly disagree with. Other commenters are using insults, and you want to reply.

options.text: Address the claim calmly and ask a clear question.
options.consequence: The response gives the discussion something specific to examine.

options.text: Mock the person's appearance.
options.consequence: The reply leaves the claim unanswered and targets their dignity.

options.text: Repeat the most insulting comment.
options.consequence: Repetition can amplify hostility rather than clarify the issue.

scenarios.followup: The person replies with an insult instead of an answer.

options2.text: Set a boundary or leave the exchange without another insult.
options2.consequence: You can end an unproductive exchange without escalating it.

options2.text: Search for their private information.
options2.consequence: That moves the dispute into an intrusion on privacy.

options2.text: Invite friends to attack the account.
options2.consequence: A group response can multiply the harm.

scenarios.takeaway: A useful response focuses on the issue and respects boundaries.

passage.arabic: وَقُل لِّعِبَادِى يَقُولُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ يَنزَغُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ كَانَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ عَدُوًّا مُّبِينًا
passage.translation: Tell My bondmen to speak that which is kindlier. Lo! the devil soweth discord among them. Lo! the devil is for man an open foe.

scenarios.title: A loan between friends
scenarios.scene: A friend asks to borrow money until next month. You both agree, but neither has written down the amount or repayment date.

options.text: Record the agreed amount and date in a message both can confirm.
options.consequence: A shared record reduces uncertainty about the agreement.

options.text: Avoid discussing the date because it feels awkward.
options.consequence: The repayment expectation stays unclear.

options.text: Add a new fee later without agreement.
options.consequence: Changing the arrangement afterward can create a dispute.

scenarios.followup: Next month, your friend asks for more time.
scenarios.prompt2: How do you approach the conversation?

options2.text: Discuss what is realistic and document any mutually agreed change.
options2.consequence: Both of you can understand the revised arrangement.

options2.text: Publicly post about the debt before speaking to them.
options2.consequence: Public pressure may expose private circumstances.

options2.text: Pretend that a different amount was originally agreed.
options2.consequence: An inaccurate claim damages the trust needed to resolve the debt.

scenarios.takeaway: Clear records support honest conversations about obligations.

passage.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَدَايَنتُم بِدَيْنٍ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى فَٱكْتُبُوهُ ۚ وَلْيَكْتُب بَّيْنَكُمْ كَاتِبٌۢ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ كَاتِبٌ أَن يَكْتُبَ كَمَا عَلَّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ فَلْيَكْتُبْ وَلْيُمْلِلِ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلْيَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُۥ وَلَا يَبْخَسْ مِنْهُ شَيْـًٔا ۚ فَإِن كَانَ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ سَفِيهًا أَوْ ضَعِيفًا أَوْ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَن يُمِلَّ هُوَ فَلْيُمْلِلْ وَلِيُّهُۥ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ وَٱسْتَشْهِدُوا۟ شَهِيدَيْنِ مِن رِّجَالِكُمْ ۖ فَإِن لَّمْ يَكُونَا رَجُلَيْنِ فَرَجُلٌ وَٱمْرَأَتَانِ مِمَّن تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءِ أَن تَضِلَّ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا فَتُذَكِّرَ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءُ إِذَا مَا دُعُوا۟ ۚ وَلَا تَسْـَٔمُوٓا۟ أَن تَكْتُبُوهُ صَغِيرًا أَوْ كَبِيرًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقْوَمُ لِلشَّهَـٰدَةِ وَأَدْنَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَرْتَابُوٓا۟ ۖ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ تِجَـٰرَةً حَاضِرَةً تُدِيرُونَهَا بَيْنَكُمْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَلَّا تَكْتُبُوهَا ۗ وَأَشْهِدُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُضَآرَّ كَاتِبٌ وَلَا شَهِيدٌ ۚ وَإِن تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَإِنَّهُۥ فُسُوقٌۢ بِكُمْ ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
passage.translation: O ye who believe! When ye contract a debt for a fixed term, record it in writing. Let a scribe record it in writing between you in (terms of) equity. No scribe should refuse to write as Allah hath taught him, so let him write, and let him who incurreth the debt dictate, and let him observe his duty to Allah his Lord, and diminish naught thereof. But if he who oweth the debt is of low understanding, or weak, or unable himself to dictate, then let the guardian of his interests dictate in (terms of) equity. And call to witness, from among your men, two witnesses. And if two men be not (at hand) then a man and two women, of such as ye approve as witnesses, so that if the one erreth (through forgetfulness) the other will remember. And the witnesses must not refuse when they are summoned. Be not averse to writing down (the contract) whether it be small or great, with (record of) the term thereof. That is more equitable in the sight of Allah and more sure for testimony, and the best way of avoiding doubt between you; save only in the case when it is actual merchandise which ye transfer among yourselves from hand to hand. In that case it is no sin for you if ye write it not. And have witnesses when ye sell one to another, and let no harm be done to scribe or witness. If ye do (harm to them) lo! it is a sin in you. Observe your duty to Allah. Allah is teaching you. And Allah is knower of all things.

scenarios.title: Two friends, one disagreement
scenarios.scene: Two friends ask you to take sides after a misunderstanding. Each has told you only their own version.

options.text: Listen fairly and ask whether they want help clarifying the misunderstanding.
options.consequence: You avoid deciding before hearing the relevant accounts.

options.text: Choose the friend you have known longer.
options.consequence: Length of friendship does not settle what happened.

options.text: Share both accounts widely for public voting.
options.consequence: A public vote can turn a private disagreement into a spectacle.

scenarios.followup: Both agree to a calm conversation.

options2.text: Give each time to speak and identify a specific point they can resolve.
options2.consequence: A focused process can make repair more manageable.

options2.text: Force an immediate apology before hearing the issue.
options2.consequence: A forced response may leave the underlying misunderstanding intact.

options2.text: Promise that you can solve every part of the dispute.
options2.consequence: An unrealistic promise can make the process harder.

scenarios.takeaway: Support reconciliation with fairness, consent, and a realistic process.

passage.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
passage.translation: The believers are naught else than brothers. Therefore make peace between your brethren and observe your duty to Allah that haply ye may obtain mercy.

scenarios.title: The lost wallet
scenarios.scene: You find a wallet in a shared study room. A student ID is inside, along with cash.

options.text: Use the institution's lost-property process and record where it was found.
options.consequence: A recognized process can help return the wallet safely.

options.text: Keep the cash as a reward.
options.consequence: The owner has not agreed to that payment.

options.text: Post a photo showing all the ID details.
options.consequence: The post unnecessarily exposes personal information.

scenarios.followup: Someone claims the wallet but cannot describe it.

options2.text: Let the designated staff verify ownership before handing it over.
options2.consequence: Verification reduces the risk of giving it to the wrong person.

options2.text: Hand it over because they sound confident.
options2.consequence: Confidence alone does not establish ownership.

options2.text: Ask them to pay you before checking.
options2.consequence: A payment demand does not help establish the owner.

scenarios.takeaway: Returning a trust includes taking reasonable care about who receives it.

passage.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَن تُؤَدُّوا۟ ٱلْأَمَـٰنَـٰتِ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهَا وَإِذَا حَكَمْتُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ أَن تَحْكُمُوا۟ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ نِعِمَّا يَعِظُكُم بِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
passage.translation: Lo! Allah commandeth you that ye restore deposits to their owners, and, if ye judge between mankind, that ye judge justly. Lo! comely is this which Allah admonisheth you. Lo! Allah is ever Hearer, Seer.

scenarios.title: The newcomer's accent
scenarios.scene: A student from another country joins your group. Their accent is unfamiliar, and someone suggests they should avoid presenting.

options.text: Ask about their strengths and offer the same opportunity to contribute.
options.consequence: The group can make decisions based on abilities and preferences.

options.text: Assume their accent means they understand less.
options.consequence: Accent does not establish someone's knowledge.

options.text: Imitate the accent to break the ice.
options.consequence: The joke may make the newcomer feel singled out.

scenarios.followup: The student wants to present but asks for a practice session.

options2.text: Offer constructive practice and ask what feedback they would find useful.
options2.consequence: Support follows their chosen goal rather than replacing it.

options2.text: Take over the presentation without asking.
options2.consequence: That removes the opportunity they asked to try.

options2.text: Publish a clip of the practice for laughs.
options2.consequence: Private practice becomes a source of public embarrassment.

scenarios.takeaway: Make room to know people beyond assumptions about background.

passage.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَـٰكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتْقَىٰكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ
passage.translation: O mankind! Lo! We have created you male and female, and have made you nations and tribes that ye may know one another. Lo! the noblest of you, in the sight of Allah, is the best in conduct. Lo! Allah is Knower, Aware.

scenarios.title: Giving without a name
scenarios.scene: A community fundraiser offers the choice to display your name or contribute privately. You want to help and also encourage others.

options.text: Choose a method that supports the cause while respecting recipients' privacy.
options.consequence: You consider both the fundraising purpose and the people affected.

options.text: Publish recipients' details to make the appeal more emotional.
options.consequence: Their private circumstances become public without a clear need.

options.text: Assume that every visible donation is automatically worthless.
options.consequence: That makes a sweeping judgment about other people's intentions.

scenarios.followup: The organizer wants to thank donors.

options2.text: An agreed acknowledgment or an overall total without exposing recipients.
options2.consequence: The update can thank supporters and protect private details.

options2.text: A ranking that labels small donors as less caring.
options2.consequence: The ranking makes assumptions about people's means and intentions.

options2.text: Private messages from families asking for help.
options2.consequence: The update reveals information that was shared for assistance.

scenarios.takeaway: Consider purpose, consent, and dignity when deciding what to make public.

passage.arabic: إِن تُبْدُوا۟ ٱلصَّدَقَـٰتِ فَنِعِمَّا هِىَ ۖ وَإِن تُخْفُوهَا وَتُؤْتُوهَا ٱلْفُقَرَآءَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۚ وَيُكَفِّرُ عَنكُم مِّن سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
passage.translation: If ye publish your almsgiving, it is well, but if ye hide it and give it to the poor, it will be better for you, and will atone for some of your ill-deeds. Allah is Informed of what ye do.

scenarios.title: The group project agreement
scenarios.scene: Your group divided a project into tasks. You finish yours, but another member is struggling and asks to change the plan.

options.text: Discuss the request openly and agree on any changes together.
options.consequence: The group can adjust expectations transparently.

options.text: Change everyone's tasks without telling them.
options.consequence: People may continue working from an outdated agreement.

options.text: Delete the struggling member's name immediately.
options.consequence: The response skips a conversation about what happened.

scenarios.followup: The group agrees to a smaller task and a new deadline.

options2.text: Write down the new responsibilities and check that everyone agrees.
options2.consequence: A shared record makes the revised plan clear.

options2.text: Keep the original plan in public and the new plan private.
options2.consequence: Two versions can create confusion and unfair expectations.

options2.text: Promise to finish every task yourself without checking your time.
options2.consequence: A new unrealistic commitment can repeat the problem.

scenarios.takeaway: Respect agreements and make changes clearly with the people affected.

passage.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَوْفُوا۟ بِٱلْعُقُودِ ۚ أُحِلَّتْ لَكُم بَهِيمَةُ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ غَيْرَ مُحِلِّى ٱلصَّيْدِ وَأَنتُمْ حُرُمٌ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ مَا يُرِيدُ
passage.translation: O ye who believe! Fulfil your indentures. The beast of cattle is made lawful unto you (for food) except that which is announced unto you (herein), game being unlawful when ye are on the pilgrimage. Lo! Allah ordaineth that which pleaseth Him.

scenarios.title: A tired caregiver
scenarios.scene: A family member caring for a parent looks exhausted. You have a free hour but are unsure what would actually help.

options.text: Ask which specific task would be most helpful in the time you have.
options.consequence: You offer practical support without assuming what is needed.

options.text: Tell them to manage their time better.
options.consequence: The comment may overlook the work and strain involved.

options.text: Promise unlimited help that you cannot sustain.
options.consequence: An open-ended promise may create an expectation you cannot meet.

scenarios.followup: They ask you to collect a prescription.

options2.text: Confirm the details and follow the pharmacy's instructions.
options2.consequence: Careful attention helps complete the practical task safely.

options2.text: Choose a different medicine based on a social-media post.
options2.consequence: An unqualified substitution can introduce a health risk.

options2.text: Share the prescription publicly to ask strangers what to do.
options2.consequence: That unnecessarily reveals private health information.

scenarios.takeaway: Small, dependable acts can support people carrying family responsibilities.

passage.arabic: وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُۥ وَهْنًا عَلَىٰ وَهْنٍ وَفِصَـٰلُهُۥ فِى عَامَيْنِ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَيْكَ إِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
passage.translation: And We have enjoined upon man concerning his parents - His mother beareth him in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years - Give thanks unto Me and unto thy parents. Unto Me is the journeying

scenarios.title: A confident answer
scenarios.scene: A friend asks you a religious question in a chat. You remember seeing a short clip but cannot recall its source or qualifications.

options.text: Say what you do not know and help locate a qualified, verifiable source.
options.consequence: You avoid presenting an uncertain memory as established knowledge.

options.text: Give a definite answer because hesitation looks weak.
options.consequence: Confidence can hide the fact that the source has not been checked.

options.text: Invent the name of a scholar who might agree.
options.consequence: An invented attribution makes the answer harder to verify.

scenarios.followup: You find two credible explanations addressing different circumstances.

options2.text: Share the sources with their circumstances and suggest qualified advice for the personal case.
options2.consequence: You preserve the distinctions that affect the answer.

options2.text: Merge them into one definite rule of your own.
options2.consequence: The differences between the explanations disappear.

options2.text: Choose whichever answer gets more likes.
options2.consequence: Popularity does not establish whether the circumstances match.

scenarios.takeaway: Distinguish verified knowledge, uncertainty, and personal application.

passage.arabic: وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْبَصَرَ وَٱلْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْـُٔولًا
passage.translation: (O man), follow not that whereof thou hast no knowledge. Lo! the hearing and the sight and the heart - of each of these it will be asked.
